relations.subject: Pramod Chandra
relations.evidence: His father was the museum curator and Indologist, Moti Chandra.

relations.subject: Pramod Chandra
relations.evidence: Chandra was born in Varanasi, India, and attended Elphinstone College in Mumbai.

relations.subject: Pramod Chandra
relations.object: School of Foreign Service, Georgetown University
relations.evidence: After Elphinstone, Chandra obtained a Bachelor of Science degree from the School of Foreign Service, Georgetown University.

relations.subject: Pramod Chandra
relations.evidence: He then returned to India and joined the Department of Art and Archaeology at the Prince of Wales Museum

relations.subject: Pramod Chandra
relations.evidence: secured a PhD from the University of Bombay (now Mumbai) in 1964.

relations.subject: Pramod Chandra
relations.evidence: Chandra then moved to the United States to join University of Chicago, where he became a professor in 1971. He remained there until 1980

relations.subject: Pramod Chandra
relations.role: George P. Bickford Professor of Indian and South Asian Art
relations.evidence: the George P. Bickford Professor of Indian and South Asian Art at Harvard University from 1980 until 2004.
